content.title: AMD, Intel and TSMC brace for Nvidia earnings: trending stocks
content.description:
Stocks of chipmakers including AMD (AMD), Intel (INTC) and TSMC (TSM, TSMC.BA) waver as markets hold their breath ahead of Nvidia (NVDA)'s earnings report. Cloudflare (NET) ticks up despite a widespread outage. Tesla (TSLA) challenger Xiaomi (1810.HK, XIACY, XIACF, 3CP.F, 1810N.MX) sees shares plummet - even as its EV arm turns an operating profit for the first time. Following a crisis sparked by an accounting error in its North American division, British high-street retailer WH Smith (SMWH.L) pushes for a turnaround. And Doordash (DASH) delivers some news - including a new partnership.

For more live coverage of the markets, watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and visit Yahoo Finance.
